task.title: Define RED tests for relay v2 publish and atomic idempotent claim
task.description: Create shared TypeScript/Go fixtures and failing Go tests for immutable Signal bundle v2 publication, permanent one-time-prekey uniqueness, atomic claim, and claim-id replay.
task.scope: packages/protocol fixtures and apps/relay v2 tests only

acceptance_criteria: Shared fixtures are accepted/rejected consistently by TypeScript and Go validation.
Byte-identical bundle publication is idempotent and a changed body under the same bundle_id conflicts.
The same OTK cannot be republished under a new bundle/key id, after expiry, claim, or relay restart.
At least twenty concurrent claim IDs produce exactly one allocation.
Retrying the same claim_id and selector returns the exact stored bundle; changing selector conflicts.
V1 routes and tests remain unchanged and green outside the deliberate RED v2 tests.
constraints: Load and follow tests-creator and the project testing skill; preserve RED-before-GREEN evidence.
Do not edit flow.json or acceptance-criteria.md.
Do not modify apps/cli; another worker owns that scope.
Use keryx ctx rg for searches and apply_patch for file edits.
Do not commit: this repository has an unborn untracked baseline, so partial root commits are forbidden.
Write a valid subagent-result to .metaproject/flows/001-2026-09-05-echolet-assessment-fixes/dispatches/001-T22-tests-result.json and make the final response start with STATUS:.

provenance.source_request: Implement the approved Echolet CLI prototype through flow-orchestrator.
